texts:
Here's the list of years from 1924 to 2014 with 3 notable works and the age the works will be in 2024:

1. 1924:
   - "The Great Gatsby" by F. Scott Fitzgerald
   - "The Thief of Bagdad" (silent film, 1926 UK release)
   - The Jazz Singer (film, 1927 US release)
   Age in 2024: 100 years old

2. 1934:
   - "Rebecca" by Daphne du Maurier
   - "It Happened One Night" (film)
   - "The Thin Man" (film)
   Age in 2024: 90 years old

3. 1944:
   - "The Master and Margarita" by Mikhail Bulgakov
   - "Double Indemnity" (film)
   - "Gaslight" (film)
   Age in 2024: 80 years old

4. 1954:
   - "Julius Caesar" by Broadway production
   - "20,000 Leagues Under the Sea" (film)
   - "Rebel Without a Cause" (film)
   Age in 2024: 70 years old

5. 1964:
   - "Dr. Strangelove" by Stanley Kubrick (script published)
   - "Goldfinger" (film)
   - "A Hard Day's Night" (film)
   Age in 2024: 60 years old

6. 1974:
   - "Jaws" by Peter Benchley
   - "Chinatown" (film)
   - "Jaws" (film)
   Age in 2024: 50 years old

7. 1984:
   - "The Hunger Games" by Suzanne Collins (published as a trilogy, but the first book is from this year)
   - "Amadeus" (film)
   - "Beverly Hills Cop" (film)
   Age in 2024: 40 years old

8. 1994:
   - "The Notebook" by Nicholas Sparks
   - "Speed" (film)
   - "Pulp Fiction" (film)
   Age in 2024: 30 years old

9. 2004:
   - "Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince" by J.K. Rowling
   - "The Passion of the Christ" (film)
   - "Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind" (film)
   Age in 2024: 20 years old

10. 2014:
    - "The Silmarillion" by Christopher Tolkien (published posthumously)
    - "Captain America: The Winter Soldier" (film)
    - "Gone Girl" (film)
    Age in 2024: 10 years old

Here's the list of notable works from each year, starting from 1924 and increasing in increments of 10, along with their age in 2024:

1. 1924

   - 'The Thief of Bagdad' (silent film)
   - 'Rhapsody in Blue' by George Gershwin (music)

   In 2024, these works will be 100 years old.

2. 1934

   In 2024, these works will be 90 years old.

3. 1944

   In 2024, these works will be 80 years old.

4. 1954

   In 2024, these works will be 70 years old.

5. 1964
   - 'Charlie and the Chocolate Factory' by Roald Dahl (book)

   In 2024, these works will be 60 years old.

6. 1974

   In 2024, these works will be 50 years old.

7. 1984
   - 'The Handmaid's Tale' by Margaret Atwood (book)

   In 2024, these works will be 40 years old.

8. 1994
   - 'The Client' by John Grisham (book)
   - 'Pulp Fiction' (film)
   - 'Waterfalls' by TLC (music)

   In 2024, these works will be 30 years old.

9. 2004
   - 'The Da Vinci Code' by Dan Brown (book)
   - 'Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind' (film)
   - 'Yeah!' by Usher (music)

   In 2024, these works will be 20 years old.

10. 2014
    - 'All the Light We Cannot See' by Anthony Doerr (book)
    - 'Boyhood' (film)
    - 'Happy' by Pharrell Williams (music)

    In 2024, these works will be 10 years old.

1924:
1. "The Waste Land" by T.S. Eliot
2. "Gigi" by Colette
3. "The Scoundrel" (film directed by Raoul Walsh)

In 2024, "The Waste Land" will be 100 years old, "Gigi" will be 100 years old, and "The Scoundrel" will be 100 years old.

1934:
1. "Brave New World" by Aldous Huxley
2. "Top Hat" (musical film directed by Mark Sandrich)
3. "The Thin Man" (film directed by W.S. Van Dyke)

In 2024, "Brave New World" will be 90 years old, "Top Hat" will be 90 years old, and "The Thin Man" will be 90 years old.

1944:
1. "Animal Farm" by George Orwell
2. "Casablanca" (film directed by Michael Curtiz)
3. "The Merry Widow" (musical directed by Ernst Lubitsch)

In 2024, "Animal Farm" will be 80 years old, "Casablanca" will be 80 years old, and "The Merry Widow" will be 80 years old.

1954:
1. "The Catcher in the Rye" by J.D. Salinger
2. "On the Waterfront" (film directed by Elia Kazan)
3. "The Band Wagon" (musical film directed by Vincente Minnelli)

In 2024, "The Catcher in the Rye" will be 70 years old, "On the Waterfront" will be 70 years old, and "The Band Wagon" will be 70 years old.

1964:
1. "Doctor Zhivago" by Boris Pasternak
2. "My Fair Lady" (musical film directed by George Cukor)
3. "The Great Race" (comedy film directed by Blake Edwards)

In 2024, "Doctor Zhivago" will be 60 years old, "My Fair Lady" will be 60 years old, and "The Great Race" will be 60 years old.

1974:
1. "The Godfather Part II" (film directed by Francis Ford Coppola)
2. "All the President's Men" (directed by Alan J. Pakula)
3. "War and Peace" (TV mini-series by BBC)

In 2024, "The Godfather Part II" will be 50 years old, "All the President's Men" will be 50 years old, and "War and Peace" will be 50 years old.

1984:
1. "The Crowded Room" by Martin Amis
2. "Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom" (film directed by Steven Spielberg)
3. "Miami Vice" (TV series)

In 2024, "The Crowded Room" will be 40 years old, "Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom" will be 40 years old, and "Miami Vice" will be 40 years old.

1994:
1. "The Girl with the Pearl Earring" by Tracy Chevalier
2. "Pulp Fiction" (film directed by Quentin Tarantino)
3. "Cracker" (TV series)

In 2024, "The Girl with the Pearl Earring" will be 30 years old, "Pulp Fiction" will be 30 years old, and "Cracker" will be 30 years old.

2004:
1. "Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince" by J.K. Rowling
2. "V for Vendetta" (film directed by James McTeigue)
3. "Shadow of the Colossus" (video game developed by Team Ico)

In 2024, "Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince" will be 20 years old, "V for Vendetta" will be 20 years old, and "Shadow of the Colossus" will be 20 years old.

2014:
1. "The Fault in Our Stars" by John Green
2. "Birdman" (film directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu)
3. "The Last of Us" (video game developed by Naughty Dog)

In 2024, "The Fault in Our Stars" will be 10 years old, "Birdman" will be 10 years old, and "The Last of Us" will be 10 years old.
